Elements.Name: BossBattle
Description: Did some things with Sonic that changes his combo table a little bit.

Elements.Name: SonicAnmSpeed
Description: If you prefer his default animation speed or if you're using other mods that have their own speed values, leave this off.

Elements.Name: BossCombat
Description: Using Combat Mods? Or are you by chance playing Extreme Mode or just running through the game normally with base level Sonic. Activate this option here. This changes the Boss's HP to a lower value that certain combat mods or a Level 1 Power Sonic can handle, gives rings though cylooping and Grand Slamming Giganto, Knight, and Supreme (not Riflebeast).

Elements.Name: IncludeDir1
Description: For Wyvern and Knight, a toggle option for default black or Purple Wyvern and Red Knight.

Elements.Name: IncludeDir2
Description: Choose between 3 batches of QTE Scenes for Supreme.

Elements.Name: BossRifleWing
Description: An alternate event for Supreme's Wing Laser QTE will play at low health.

Elements.Name: RifleShieldFix
Description: https://gamebanana.com/threads/228353 for more info. - This is a toggle option only for those facing a known crash problem with a specific attack, parrying the flurry of Supreme's back-arms causing the game to crash.

Elements.Name: BossZevRifleSp00
Description: This option only affects Final Horizons due to issues I can't fix fully for the base game. The event now does damage and will deduct 10% of the boss health. The scene only triggers through XInput for now. I do not know how to get it working for other controller types.

Elements.Name: RifleBeastYap
Description: Choose wheather the fight will have The End monologue during cutscenes or not.

If you're using other combat mods because HMM code overrides file changes. Or if you want the skill set from vanilla.

Homing Shot moved to be a combo after Loop Kick, Wild Rush, or Spin Slash by using Sonic Boom. Can also be comboed after boost by using the Sonic Boom action when near an enemy. When fighting Supreme, the Grand Slam can be comboed after Spinslash by using Cyloop. This action will use up meter on top of breaking through Supreme's drone defense. Alternatively, Grand Slam can be comboed after Quick Cyloop by hitting Jump when fighting Supreme. Will also consume meter and break through Supreme's defense. Both these actions will fling Supreme in to the air immediately however this only occurs with the Unused Grand Slam option enabled.
